title: DiagFlowBench: Evaluating How Language Models Handle Off-Procedure Inputs in Grounded Diagnostic Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2606.17904v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models increasingly serve as advisory systems in maintenance operations. To prevent hallucination, recent systems ground these models in procedural documentation to constrain them to approved steps. In practice, however, operator queries frequently stray from this path, requiring models to recognise out-of-scope inputs mid-conversation, a dynamic that current benchmarks rarely prioritise. We introduce DiagFlowBench, a dataset of 50 industrial diagnostic flowcharts from a consumer manufacturer converted into 1,676 multi-turn conversations that contrast compliant with out-of-scope utterances. Evaluating a panel of ten commercial and open-weight models reveals high variability in abstention rates, with models commonly selecting a real but contextually inadequate step rather than fabricating facts. The inherent plausibility and authority of this mapped but wrong advice exposes a challenging vulnerability for grounding systems.

translated_title: DiagFlowBench：评估语言模型在基于规程的诊断对话中如何处理偏离规程的输入
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.17904v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：语言模型越来越多地作为维护操作中的咨询系统。为了防止幻觉，近期系统将这些模型基于程序文档进行约束，以限制其遵循批准的步骤。然而，在实践中，操作员查询经常偏离此路径，要求模型在对话中途识别超出范围输入，而当前基准测试很少优先考虑这种动态。我们引入了DiagFlowBench，这是一个来自消费制造商的50个工业诊断流程图数据集，转换为1,676个多轮对话，对比了合规与超出范围的表述。评估一组十个商业和开放权重模型显示，在弃权率方面存在高度变异性，模型通常选择一个真实但上下文不充分的步骤，而不是捏造事实。这种映射但错误的建议固有的合理性和权威性，暴露了基础系统的一个挑战性漏洞。
tldr: 本文提出了DiagFlowBench数据集和评估框架，揭示语言模型在诊断对话中面对偏离规程输入时，常选择不恰当但看似合理的步骤，而非直接虚构，这暴露了基础系统在识别超出范围输入方面的关键弱点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DiagFlowBench, a dataset and evaluation framework revealing that language models in diagnostic dialogues often select plausible but contextually inadequate steps when handling off-procedure inputs, rather than fabricating facts, exposing a critical vulnerability in grounding systems.
